Class AnalystReportRepository

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst.AnalystReportRepository
@Repository public class AnalystReportRepository extends Object
Reads the analyst reports' figures from the reporting schema: reporting.client_months (one row per client per UTC month they ordered in) for activity and value, reporting.orders where a report needs single orders, and reporting.clients for sign-ups. Plain SQL rather than JPA: every query is an aggregate, and this service never writes. Months are UTC throughout, and every range is half-open, from the window's first month up to but not including the month after it.
